msg: Hi. We want to complete our PADI open water: we have referrals and e-learning certificates. We would also like a refresher first. How does the 2 day open water referral course cost plus a mini course the day before. 2 persons. Thanks
reply:
Hi! 🪸 I'm *Coral* from *Diving Planet* — we dive year-round in the Rosario Islands, departing from Cartagena or right from the islands. So happy to have you here! I'd love to help you put your plan together. 🌊

That sounds like a great plan! For two people, the exact total will be shown during booking.

The Referral Course requires you to stay overnight on the islands; accommodation isn’t included. You’ll need referral paperwork signed by a PADI instructor. The refresher is normally required if it’s been more than two years since your last dive, and it’s for already-certified divers.

I don’t have a booking link for the Referral Course handy, but you can review its details here: https://divingplanet.org/curso-padi-cartagena/referido/

The referred course requires the PADI referral form signed by your original instructor; the plan is the Open Water Referral Course, not a regular dive trip.

To give you the exact price I need to know where you're starting from: would you leave *from Cartagena* or are you already *on the Rosario Islands*? Plans and prices change depending on the departure point. 🌊

msg: Ok. Thanks. We will work out the best days. Do you recommend any hotels on the island convenient for the diving?
reply:
Absolutely! For the most convenient access to diving, our base is at *Hotel San Pedro de Majagua* and *Hotel Cocoliso* on Isla Grande, with direct boat pick-up from either hotel.

Other nearby options with maritime access include *Rosario de Mar, Secreto, Ubuntu, Mulata, Eco Hotel Las Palmeras, and Pao Pao*. Pick-up arrangements can vary by hotel, and accommodation is booked directly with the hotel—not included in the dive plan.

Do you have a particular hotel in mind? I can help check what to keep in mind for pick-up.

If you’re staying on the islands, pick-up and return are at your hotel if it has maritime access.

Where would you be departing from? This plan takes 2 days and you need to *stay on the islands* (accommodation is not included): you can leave *from Cartagena* on the first day or, if you're already *on the islands*, we arrange pickup at your hotel.

msg: Great. We will book diving with you on the website and will book our hotel on the island . Hope you are operating on Easter Sunday? We want to dive on April 5 and 6. How do we book/pay for the $50 refresher course?

Yes, we operate on Easter Sunday; we’re open every day except December 25 and January 1, weather permitting. April 5 and 6 sound like a lovely plan! 🌊

Since you’ll be staying on the islands, book the refresher as *“Dive Mini Course (already on the islands)”*. The online price is *USD 134 per person*—the $50 price doesn’t match our current catalog. It’s a one-day refresher with hotel pick-up if your hotel has boat access; lunch isn’t included.

Book and pay online here: https://book.divingplanet.org/book/dive-mini-course-already-on-island/20?language=en

A refresher and a certified diver can join the same outing.

The refresher is normally required if it’s been more than two years since your last dive. Would you like the link for the two-day Open Water Referral Course as well?
